notes: Every URL below is linked from fastonepro.com (a Google Sites page; checked /home, /legal and /safety). `reviews: true` platforms are monitored for reviews; the rest are linked but have no reviews of FASTONE. `reported_*` values are what the platform itself showed on checked_at. `scrape_url(s)` is what scripts/pull_reviews.py feeds to the scraper; `review_page_url` is the fallback review link. Amazon `asins` / Etsy `listing_ids` limit the import to the FASTONE products the site links to.
